title: Khaak par maiyyath padi hai aur maa khaamoush hai
body:
Khaak par maiyyath padi hai aur maa khaamoush hai
Shor hai Ahl-e-Haram mein aur maa khaamoush hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Rokay kehti hai yeh Baano haaye yeh kya hogayaa
Shaahey deen ko ronay waali aaj kyun khamoush hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dafn ka saamaan Bibi kis tarhaa sey hoyegaa
Sar pa chaadar bhi nahin hai aur maa khaamoush hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Paaoon mein zanjeer dohri aur galay mein touq hai
Sar jhukaaye qaid mein Zainul-Ibaa khaamoush hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sham kay zindan ka manzar sonch aye Maryam zara
Saamney maiyyath padi hai aur maa khaamoush hai
